provenance.note: NPA-A (9 mm Luger pistols, C.7A.1) and NPA-B (pistols and revolvers .354 to .455, C.7B.1) shoot one course on two NPA faces. NPA-B may also be shot with optical sights, scored separately (C.7B.7, Teil C, PDF p. 37). The course runs at 25, 20, 15 and 10 m, the record holds the longest distance.
